notes:
Summary of account and technical needs:
- Company: Claritone builds analytics and coaching tools for enterprise contact centers. Very focused on post-call value: transcript + QA auto-scores + coaching highlights.
- Primary ask: replace brittle in-house summarization pipeline with a low-latency, reliable post-call summarizer that integrates into their QA workflow and feeds coaching highlights into their LMS.
- Traffic profile: peak inbound bursts (campaign days) ~6k calls/hour. Need graceful behavior during spikes; can't drop calls.
- Latency SLO: post-call summary available within 10s for recording-based flow; live agent-assist needs <300ms token latency for real-time hints.
- Models: prefer open models (cost), but open to Redwood-verified variants; will need quantized on-prem artifacts for air-gapped customers.
- Routing/fallback: multi-tier routing required — hosted for low-touch accounts, dedicated for large customers, on-prem for regulated telco clients. Automatic fallback to smaller model if quantized variant not available.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retained 2 years, and EU data residency for several customers.
- Quote from Head of Product (call 2026-03-08): "We need summaries that coaching leads trust — highlight the top 2 improvement areas and give verbatim quote snippets. If the model hallucinates, it's worse than nothing."
- POC plan: 2-week POC with 1) ingest of recorded calls, 2) live streaming hook for agent assist in a volunteer queue, 3) QA-rule accuracy evaluation vs. human raters. Metrics: precision/recall on QA categories, average summary ROUGE-lite score vs baseline, end-to-end latency.
- Integration notes: Wants a simple webhook for summary posts plus an optional S3 sink for transcripts. Also asked for a sample function-call schema for 'coaching_highlights' (we provided a draft during demo).
- Operational ask: must include surge autoscaling plan and circuit-breaker behavior doc for heavy-burst days. SE asked for example autoscale config and cost math.

Sample post-call summary (used in demo, rough):
Caller: "My bill spiked this month — I want a breakdown."
Agent: "I'll pull last month's usage and review the charges."
Auto-summary: "Issue: unexpected billing spike. Agent verified usage and offered to escalate to billing ops. Coaching highlights: Agent used empathetic framing ('I can see how frustrating that is'); missed opportunity: did not proactively offer usage dashboard walkthrough. Suggested play: confirm next steps and schedule a 10-min follow-up. QA score: 78/100 (categories: empathy 9/10, resolution 7/10, procedural correctness 8/10)."

CRM-style friction notes: legal wants more explicit E2E encryption detail for on-prem builds. Infra wants to validate that KV cache for caller context won't leak across tenants in shared dedicated pools. Procurement pushing for 12-month commitment; finance needs ARR estimate to compare to NICE renewal.
